LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Knife.label: industrial knife
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Knife.description: One of the oldest tools in human history - a blade with a handle. Useful for stabbing people and there's not a single job that doesn't benefit from a knife. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Gladius.label: industrial gladius
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Gladius.descripti: A short sword invented by the Romans. Its main use is to stab. And then twist. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Longsword.label: industrial longsword
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Longsword.descrip: A two-handed, long-bladed weapon invented for one-to-one combat. Useful for slashing and stabbing. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Hammer.label: industrial hammer
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Hammer.descriptio: A nifty tool/weapon that can both be used to put nails in, and allows you to cosplay that your enemies are nails. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Polehammer.label: industrial polehammer
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Polehammer.descri: A combination of two ancient designs: a hammer, and a long stick. It's used to bludgeon enemies' armor inwards, hurting them with blunt trauma and sharp edges of their own apparel. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Mace.label: industrial mace
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Mace.description: A weapon designed for tackling mechanoids. Mounted electrical capacitors reload with the strikes and discharge EM Pulses to stun the attacked machine. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Baton.label: industrial baton
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Baton.description: A less-than-lethal applicator of blunt trauma to foreheads. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Spear.label: industrial spear
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Spear.description: Possibly the oldest and most prolific weapon design in history of mankind. A tipped blade on a long stick. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Shield.label: industrial shield
LanguageData.Bamba_Melee_Industrial_Shield.descriptio: A piece of hard material that's meant to be put between you and your enemy. This one is made from industrial-grade steel and more sophisticated than the ones one could smith together from whatever material.
